text: 今年以来，中国进出口银行充分发挥政策性金融职能作用，加大资源倾斜力度，全力支持制造业高质量发展，助力构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系。今年1—7月，中国进出口银行新发放制造业贷款近5000亿元，重点支持了传统产业转型升级、新兴产业发展壮大、未来产业提前布局等领域，其中先进制造业贷款近2000亿元，占比40%。 (央视新闻)
text_en: Since the start of this year, the Export-Import Bank of China has leveraged its policy finance role, increased resource allocation, and fully supported high-quality manufacturing development, helping build a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing. From January to July this year, the bank issued nearly 500 billion yuan in new manufacturing loans, focusing on areas such as traditional industry transformation and upgrading, emerging industry growth, and forward-looking layout of future industries, of which advanced manufacturing loans totaled nearly 200 billion yuan, accounting for 40%. (CCTV News)
